verdict: Dow's sales rose 13% to $11.3B as polyethylene prices jumped, lifting operating EBIT nearly fivefold to $887M and GAAP earnings to $0.62 a share from $0.08.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Net sales were $11,267M — local prices up 14%, volumes down 1%

kpis.label: Operating EPS
kpis.note: Excludes $0.09 of significant items — restructuring and transformation costs, partly offset by a litigation gain

kpis.label: Operating EBIT
kpis.note: vs $180M a year ago — Dow's headline profit measure, before interest and tax

segments.name: Packaging & Specialty Plastics
segments.note: Polyethylene and other plastics for packaging — half of all sales. Local prices rose 17% and volumes 1%, driving the quarter.

segments.name: Industrial Intermediates & Infrastructure
segments.note: Polyurethanes, construction chemicals and industrial solutions. Prices rose 16% but volumes fell 7%, including Middle East conflict impacts.

segments.name: Performance Materials & Coatings
segments.note: Silicones, coatings and performance monomers. Prices up 5% and volumes up 3%.

segments.name: Corporate
segments.note: Small corporate and other sales that do not belong to a segment.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling and running the company — includes $60M of Transform to Outperform program costs (see one-time items).

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Developing new materials and processes — down slightly from $191M a year ago.

opex.name: Amortization of intangibles
opex.note: Writing down the value of brands, patents and customer relationships bought in past deals, year by year.

opex.name: Restructuring & asset charges
opex.note: Restructuring and asset-related charges under Dow's cost-saving programs.

otherDetail: Equity earnings from joint ventures of $12M, sundry income of $50M and interest income of $50M, less $211M of interest expense and the $67M of profit belonging to noncontrolling partners — a net $166M cost. What remains is the $458M available to Dow's common stockholders (total net income was $525M).
follow100Note: Kept-as-profit is the $458M available to common stockholders; the rows net to $100.01 due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Prices did all the work
takeaways.text: Sales rose 13% to $11,267M because local prices rose 14% — led by polyethylene, up 17% in Packaging & Specialty Plastics — while volumes actually fell 1%. Every segment grew, with Packaging & Specialty Plastics up 18% to $5,778M.

takeaways.title: Operating profit nearly quintupled
takeaways.text: Operating EBIT — Dow's preferred profit measure — rose to $887M from $180M a year ago on higher prices and self-help cost savings, more than offsetting raw-material and logistics costs. Operating cash flow was $1.8B and free cash flow $1.1B.

takeaways.title: One-offs trimmed reported EPS
takeaways.text: GAAP EPS was $0.62 vs operating EPS of $0.71. Significant items cost $0.09 a share: $69M of Transform to Outperform costs, $31M of restructuring-program implementation and a $53M loss on paying off debt early, partly offset by a $69M litigation gain (all pre-tax).

oneTimers: Transform to Outperform program costs of $69M pre-tax ($60M in SG&A, $9M in restructuring charges) — Dow's company-wide productivity overhaul.
2025 Restructuring Program implementation costs of $31M pre-tax ($30M in cost of sales, $1M in SG&A).
A $53M pre-tax loss on early extinguishment of debt, partly offset by $69M of litigation-related gains — both inside sundry income. Total significant items: $84M pre-tax, $0.09 per share.
footerNote: Dow does not report a single 'operating income' line; operating income here is gross profit less R&D, SG&A, intangible amortization and restructuring charges, before joint-venture earnings, sundry income and interest — it reconciles to the reported $642M of pre-tax income. Net income is the $458M available to Dow Inc. common stockholders.
